title: 8 Things a Godly Man Does First So Nobody Else Has To
caption:
Real leadership isn't a title. It's going first into the cost, before anyone asks you to.

He apologizes first, even when the blame's split. He forgives before the apology comes. He takes the hit before it lands on someone weaker. Christ went first into the cost. That's the model, not a suggestion.

Save this and pick one to go first on this week.

#faith #leadership #godlyman #christianmen #servantleadership
theme: He leads by going first into the cost.
